localChanges: Scoping the viewport-buffer work turned up that `Minimap.update()` is the renderer's largest source-pixel consumer: it discards 14.7 megapixels into a 190x142 target on every patch and every recentre, 383.4 megapixels over 15s of stress play against the portal's 310.9. It is also the whole of the blocker on viewport-sized buffers, being the only thing outside `Portal` that reads a layer's `canvas()`. Filed as #53 with the decisions on what a dedicated minimap layer draws, and #54 for the click landing two tiles up and left of the tile clicked.
